profile.name: QDevil QDAC-II 多通道精密电压源
profile.name_en: QDevil QDAC-II Multi-Channel Precision Voltage Source
profile.description: QDevil QDAC-II 是一款面向量子器件与低温实验的多通道精密电压源，可输出直流偏置、列表扫描和多种波形，并支持内部/外部触发、虚拟栅校正及电流测量，常用于门电压控制、参数扫描和同步实验。
profile.description_en: The QDevil QDAC-II is a multi-channel precision voltage source for quantum-device and cryogenic experiments. It can generate DC biases, list sweeps, and multiple waveform types, and supports internal/external triggering, virtual-gate correction, and current measurement for gate control, parameter sweeps, and synchronized experiments.

registry.name: QDevil QDAC-II 24-Channel DAC
registry.description: QDevil QDAC-II 24-Channel DAC是由QDevil (Quantum Machines)生产的表征设备，主要功能包括中止、停止、写入数据、初始化、启动、复位。
